reviews.text: It now adds ideas to your list for ads including alcohol.

reviews.title: Could be great! But it isn’t!!
reviews.text:
I like ALMOST everything about Our Groceries EXCEPT the fact that if you take your eyes off the screen for a second and turn to grab an item off the shelf and BARELY touch the screen, you’ll be in another page or deleting entire lists or removing items or in an item’s listing adding more or taking quantities out or…who knows what.

I’m just about 100% sure that the developers don’t actually use the app or they’d know this because it’s a common complaint from people I’ve recommended the app to (and who subsequently stopped using it and deleted it) and my husband refuses to use it at all because of this annoyance (no, it’s NOT a feature nor a bug, it’s sloppy design).

Literally every time I use it this happens and I know from feedback from people I’ve recommended it to that they’ve experienced exactly the same issue.

If there was a border around the edge of the app where the app touches the edge of the screen, where when you accidentally touch it when you’re pushing a grocery cart in a busy supermarket, dodging other customers (with kids!), trying to load your cart, peruse your list, hold onto your phone, and look for deals (who doesn’t in THIS economy..?), having half your list deleted or changed or worse an entire list deleted because you can’t keep an eye on your screen, your fingers placed JUST SO (anyone else remember Steve Jobs telling us we were holding our iPhones wrong??),  and juggle all the other things going on around you while shopping and trying to avoid having

reviews.title: Interrupted to beg for a review
I'm abandoning this app after using it for years
reviews.text: I'm abandoning this app after using it for years because it's become so obnoxious with larger ads that now support motion.  It was never that great and now it has pushed itself below my threshold of usability.

reviews.title: Watch adds
reviews.text: Adds are not well curated. My wife mistakenly clicked on one while holding the phone and it opened with a loud, embarrassing, threatening message in the middle of a store. We have removed the app.

reviews.title: Go back to the old version PLEASE!!!
reviews.text:
How do I go back to the old version where every time I selected an item it didn’t take me all the way back to the Home Screen? This new updated version is really annoying and I miss the old way. I love the app for the convenience but this change makes me so frustrated I almost want to go back to a hand written list. 😫

Here to amend my review as I was contacted by the developer and apparently there is a place in the settings that allows you to change this and “add multiple items” but I’m only adding one more star because I am still frustrated that it would change without notice and not keep the original settings. Why not keep the original setting then have you go to settings and change it to only add one at a time if that’s what you want?! Change is hard enough for people don’t make decisions for us too. 🙄😆

reviews.title: Won’t Work on IPhone 16 Pro
reviews.text: Have used this grocery app for many years and share it with my spouse. It worked wonderfully until iOS 26 update ruined most third party apps. This app hasn’t opened since.

reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.text: There was an update recently that added a few steps for rearranging my items. Too many steps!

reviews.title: No Search?
reviews.text: Nice app accept you have to scroll through the whole list to find and item. How can an app in today’s market not include a search option. Especially one that is just a list.

reviews.title: Once Wonderful, but no more.
reviews.text: In what I suppose must be a desire to change things to use different features this app has fallen from a favorite to very irritating. I monitor my iPhone storage and I watch as the size of this app, still small, is growing in size. I attribute it to storing of duplicates. It used to be when an item was added to the physical grocery cart it was swiped off the list-to-buy to below on the same list and appears as lined out. Now they also go to an apparently shared trashed list where they are found by the search and where they can be swiped back to the list-to-buy area. That trash area grows with multiples of duplicates. It is not at all obvious how to purge the duplicates there. (Swiping them sends them to a list-to-buy area.) There are other irritations. I am now testing other shopping apps in search of a replacement.

reviews.title: Horrible!
reviews.text:
This latest revision (March 2026) is terrible! I opened the app (which I use almost every day) to find a completely foreign design. With no explanation other than "it’s easier". For whom?absolutely no idea how to navigate this new monstrosity, as there are no ‘directions’ to go to. 

The screen is green (awful to look at) and previous notes I’ve made are now at the top of my grocery list. I DON’T WANT THEM THERE! I can’t get rid of them or move them, unless I delete them word by word. I have to scroll through all of these notes to get to the groceries I’ve put on the list. Who came up with this disaster of an upgrade? You had a really good App that I’ve used for about 15 years, with decent improvements along the way. This latest version is horrible and I no longer want to use it. I guess I’m on my way to look for a more ‘user friendly’ grocery/list application.
